description: High tide and low tide times and heights (a tide table) for a US coastal place or NOAA station, today or any date, from NOAA tide predictions. location takes a place ("Santa Cruz, CA"), a NOAA station id (9414290) or lat,lon. Up to 31 days per call.

date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in station local time. Default today at the station.

location.description: Place like "Santa Cruz, CA" or "Cape May, NJ", a NOAA station id like 9414290, or "lat,lon".

name: tide_times
title: High and low tide times
